notes.title: The minor and major adjustments have been completed.
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Players![/h1]
Several modifications have been made since the game was released. I received these requests from players and Steam curators. Every idea that improved the game's quality has been implemented. I greatly appreciate the patience of everyone who has waited until now. Now it’s time to enjoy the game—have fun, everyone!

[h2]What has changed?[/h2]
[list]
    [*][b]Updated sounds:[/b] NPC interaction sounds have been modified.
    [*][b]Updated camera movement:[/b] Players can now rotate the camera position with the left mouse button, and the camera will hold its last position until a new instruction is given to move it.
[/list]

[h2]What to expect?[/h2]
[list]
    [*]Fixes for reported issues.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notice: Testing Achievement Feature
notes.content:
Update Notice: Testing Achievement Feature

In the latest update, we introduced the achievement feature, which is currently undergoing testing. Unfortunately, we have detected a technical issue that may cause the game to freeze upon startup. I am aware of the issue and am actively working on a solution. The process of identifying the source of the problem is ongoing, and I will release a new update to fix it as soon as possible.

Please be patient, and thank you for your understanding!

notes.title: Modifications Based on Steam Curator's Suggestions
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Players![/h1]
Based on suggestions from a Steam curator, a series of improvements has begun that will enhance the gameplay experience.

[h2]What has changed?[/h2]
[list]
    [*][b]Achievements:[/b] Achievements have been added to the Steam interface. Since they can only be tested after an update, I hope everything works smoothly. If any issue arises, I will fix it immediately.
    [*][b]Weather:[/b] Automatic weather and time (hours, minutes) have been introduced. For those who do not want to play in the dark, you can adjust the game time in the settings menu, and the process will continue from there.
    [*][b]Guild:[/b] The guild interface has also been updated. Event buttons have been moved from the table rows to a separate panel. The panel appears when you click on a player in the table, showing their panel, and you can use the portal if it is allowed by the game rules. The guild master can manage the guild members here, and players can leave the guild by clicking on their own name.
    [*][b]Environment:[/b] Significant changes have been made to the dungeon and battlefield maps, especially in the landscape and environment appearance. I hope you will enjoy the new look.
[/list]

[h2]What to expect?[/h2]
[list]
    [*]Further visual elements will be added to enhance the gaming experience.
[/list]

notes.title: Modifications Based on Steam Curator's Suggestions
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Players![/h1]
Based on suggestions from a Steam curator, a series of improvements has begun that will enhance the gameplay experience.

[h2]What has changed?[/h2]
[list]
    [*][b]Crafting Interface Expanded:[/b] The crafting interface has been expanded with a group filtering option. This allows for a more organized view of recipes. The text search filter will now more accurately search for the desired recipe within the selected group.
    [*][b]Volume Adjustment:[/b] The volume control has been modified. When a new player first enters the map, the default volume will now be set to 50%, which can be adjusted later in the settings menu.
    [*][b]Visual Elements:[/b] New visual elements have been added to the map, including various torches and lanterns. These respond to the in-game time of day set by the player. After dusk, they will light up and softly illuminate the surroundings.
    [*][b]Visual Elements:[/b] On the plateau, you can now view the enemies that you will face in the dungeons. Of course, they are safely locked in cages, so they pose no threat.
    [*][b]Environment:[/b] The first expansion map has also undergone visual changes, with modifications to the environment’s appearance.
[/list]

[h2]What to expect?[/h2]
[list]
    [*]Achievements earned in the game will be viewable on Steam as well.
    [*]Further visual elements will be added to enhance the gaming experience.
[/list]

notes.title: The launch of the game on Steam was filled with challenges.
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Players![/h1]
The launch of the game on Steam was challenging, but thanks to your feedback, I’ve learned and improved a lot. Since then, I’ve been working hard to take my game to the next level, and now it’s ready to offer you an even better experience.
[h2]What has changed?[/h2]
[list]
    [*][b]New multilingual tutorial videos:[/b] Now available on our YouTube channel and accessible directly from the game. The videos are organized by language, making it easy for everyone to find the content that suits them best.
    [*][b]Clarification of tasks:[/b] The text of the first quests has been revised to make it clearer what and how much needs to be collected. The first 10 introductory quests now have tutorial videos to help you better understand the basics of the game and the crafting process.
    [*][b]Friends list and communication:[/b] You can now easily meet your friends on the same server and send private messages to each other. Previously, this feature was only available within guilds, but now it’s open to all players.
    [*][b]New challenges:[/b] You can now increase achievement points during quests in each level, giving you more opportunities to enhance your characters and pets.
    [*][b]Hidden rewards:[/b] Eggs hidden on the maps contain valuable rewards, adding another reason to explore the world!
    [*][b]Visual improvements:[/b] Abilities, especially explosions, now have more impressive effects.
    [*][b]Teamplay and dungeons:[/b] Players of different levels can now play together on the battlefield and in dungeons, making it easier to team up at any time.
    [*][b]Various bug fixes:[/b] Numerous synchronization and server-side issues have been fixed to ensure a smoother gaming experience.
[/list]
I look forward to welcoming you back to the game, so you can experience everything we’ve improved. My goal is to continuously enhance the game based on your feedback, so we can reach new heights as a community. See you on the battlefield!

Explore the depths of the game! Want to learn more about our game? Check out our latest videos that provide insights into the gameplay and offer useful tips! Click the link and dive into knowledge: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dM3y303yd9w&list=PLs4dAHWLZPcKDSFXDBGxpjew7CaYp_bDC

Join our community on Discord! Want to be the first to know about the latest updates, participate in exclusive events, and chat directly with the developer? Then don’t hesitate, join our Discord community now! We’re waiting to shape the future together and share our ideas.
[b]Invite link:[/b] https://discord.gg/7nwRs3fASn

notes.title: Fixes and new features
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings, everyone![/h1]
I am pleased to inform you about the updates and new features in the latest version.
[h2]Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] The incorrect information in the Auction House popup window has been corrected.
[*] Messages sent in the local chat will now reach all players on the current server.
[/list]
[h2]New Features:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Friends List:[/b] You can now add up to 100 friends. You can send private messages to friends across servers. If the selected friend is not in PVP, Dungeon, Poker, or Private Plot areas, the portal function can be used. If the friend is on another server, the portal first transports you to that server, then directly to your friend.
[*] [b]Unwanted Message Filtering:[/b] You can now mark players whose messages you do not wish to read in the chat.
[*] [b]Redeeming Valuable Materials:[/b] The valuable materials obtained from enemies (head, leg, scissors, skin) can now be used not only for crafting characters and pets. You can now redeem these materials for points to increase the defeated enemy counter value in the Achievement interface. Each material increases the counter by 1 point.
[*] [b]Eggs in the First Expansion Map:[/b] Eggs containing valuable rewards have been placed in the first expansion map. Once a player collects an egg, it will reappear randomly within 18-30 minutes.
[/list]
[h2]Coming Soon:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Naturally, fixing all newly reported bugs.
[*] Creating new tutorial videos in 11 languages.
[/list]

notes.title: A rough start
notes.content:
[h1] Dear Players [/h1]

The launch did not go as we expected. Since this is our first released game, we had no prior experience to rely on. We set a higher price at launch than we should have. We adjusted the price to a more acceptable one.
We are continuously seeking ways to introduce the game to new players:
The game will be showcased at the autumn fair.
We are looking for streamers who will partner with us to present the game.
We are very grateful to the players who tried the game and provided feedback. We have received bug reports, which are currently being fixed, as well as creative ideas worth implementing in the game.
[h2] Bugs: [/h2]
[list]
[*] If the pet delivers the final blow to the enemy during combat, the player does not receive the Achievements points.
[/list]
We are fixing this bug and will update during the server restart. The server restart is scheduled for Wednesday, 2024.07.03 from 12:00 to 13:00 CET.
[h2] Development Suggestions: [/h2]
[list]
[*] Expand the chat function on the current server to world chat size.
[*] Add a friends list.
[*] Enable ignoring players in the chat.
[*] Increase the number of quests available on the first expansion map.
[/list]
We consider these suggestions excellent.
We continue to welcome any opportunities and ideas that can help increase the player base.

Thank you, Rebellion Against Rebellion
